Press Start — guess the movie from the emojis!

📖 How to use

  1. Look at the emoji clue and guess the movie.
  2. Type your guess and press Enter.
  3. Stuck? Press Hint to reveal letters (fewer points).
  4. Skip anytime — guess all 60+ movies!

❓ Frequently asked questions

How many movies are included?

Over 60 emoji puzzles covering classics, animation, action, and horror films.

How do hints work?

Each Hint reveals one hidden letter. More hints mean fewer points for that movie.

How exact must my guess be?

Type the movie title — matching ignores case and punctuation, so close spellings count.

How is scoring calculated?

10 points minus 2 per hint used, with a 2-point minimum. Streaks add excitement — keep guessing!
